rationale: C10 plausibly supplied the child’s concrete resignation-acceptance template. Both are personal presidential letters accepting a senior defense official’s resignation under regrettable circumstances, crediting the official’s patriotism, praising his administration of defense responsibilities, stating that the country owes him a debt, specifying an effective date, and closing with personal good wishes. The child substantially expands this framework to address the steel wage-and-price controversy, but that adaptation does not erase the distinctive shared sequence. C16 and C23 are strong secondary matches for the child’s steel-dispute and Wage Stabilization Board discussion, but they are referrals employing different administrative machinery rather than templates for accepting a resignation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I regret very much the circumstances which make you feel it is necessary to submit your resignation... I consider that it was an act of sincere patriotism on your part to accept this position
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In the terribly regrettable circumstances which have arisen... accept your proffered resignation... It is clear to me that in writing it you have been actuated by motives of the highest patriotism
shared_material.explanation: Both open the operative portion by linking regrettable circumstances, acceptance of resignation, and the official’s patriotism.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: accept your proffered resignation as Secretary of Defense, effective at the close of business on September 19, 1950
shared_material.explanation: The same concrete acceptance-and-effective-date formula is used.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I believe the Nation owes you a deep debt of gratitude for your untiring and unselfish efforts
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The country is in debt to you for your pioneering achievement
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize the official’s defense service as creating a national debt of gratitude.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shall be sorry not to have you at my side, but I wish you success and happiness in whatever future work you undertake.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: With my warm personal regards, my thanks again for your distinguished services, and my best wishes
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the resignation acceptance with personal appreciation and future good wishes.
